Primal Shadow can be obtained by combining 10 Mote of Shadow obtained from voidwalker-type Outland mobs. Prior to patch 2.1 Mote of Shadow also dropped from demons, especially mobs at the various "forge camps" and "invasion points"; however it was decided this made Primal Shadow far more common than Blizzard intended. Therefore a change was made so that only the void-type creatures of Outland would drop Mote of Shadow. Primal Shadow may be transmuted into Primal Water, and vice versa. This is learned via a discovery, which occurs when doing other transmutes.
Primal Life is created by combining 10 . It can also be transmuted by an alchemist through Transmute: Primal Earth to Life.

Primal Flamesaber is a reward from the "For Azeroth!" promotion event in Blizzard's free-to-play hero brawler game Heroes of the Storm. The event lasted from 10am PST February 14th to March 14th 2017 (exact start and end dates vary slightly by region) and required players to play 15 matches of Heroes of the Storm using a Warcraft hero while in a group with a Battle.net friend. Besides granting the Primal Flamesaber in World of Warcraft, completing the event quest also rewarded a 10-day Stimpack and a Flames of Judgement Charger mount in Heroes of the Storm. Princess Poobah is a tauren quest giver located on Jaguero Isle in the Cape of Stranglethorn. She is being held prisoner by Skymane King Mukla. Poobah has a very good throwing arm as she is able to toss many written notes in bottles out to sea. Crumpled Note informs that she was once held captive by Zanzil the Outcast.
A primal elemental or "complete elemental" is an elemental consisting of all four basic elements (air, earth, fire, water). They speak all the dialects of Kalimag: Terran, Ignan, Aquan, and Auran.
Prince Kellen is a rare satyr found in Desolace. He is known to be a very easy kill for a low level 30s person.

Primates are beasts found in various tropical areas of Azeroth, mainly Stranglethorn Vale, Feralas, Un'Goro Crater, the Lost Isles, the Jade Forest, and Zuldazar. Both monkeys and gorillas are considered primates. The hozen of Pandaria are also called monkeys, making them primates as well. Gorillas are also classified as apes.

Prince Renathal is a venthyr who leads the rebellion from Sinfall in Revendreth against Sire Denathrius. Convinced that the Master is behind the anima drought, he rallied a formidable force to lead a rebellion to succeed Sire Denathrius and make the anima flow once more. In contrast to his prideful father, Renathal is more humble and devoted to Revendreth's original mission. He also appears to enjoy taking chances on gambits that seemingly have very little chance to succeed. Despite his attacks on Castle Nathria and his attempts to unite the Court of Harvesters against Denathrius all initially ending in failure, he refuses to let the Venthyr and the Shadowlands go out without a fight. The Primus is the founder and ruler of Maldraxxus and the five houses of the Necrolord Covenant, whose charge is to defend the Shadowlands and the force of Death from external influences. The most tactical and long-thinking of the Eternal Ones, he is a master strategist who is nearly unbeatable on the field of battle and is notorious for always thinking far ahead of everyone else. The Primus embodies the five traits of the ideal Maldraxxi soldier, virtues he also instilled into the five houses: ambition, might, insight, guile, and relentlessness.
